name: pam_limits
detailed_description: Session resource limits module that enforces system resource restrictions per user session. Controls memory usage, CPU time, file descriptors, and other system resources via /etc/security/limits.conf. Prevents single users from consuming all system resources.
notes:
Controls resource limits (memory, CPU, file descriptors, etc.)
